integrated_answer.claim: Account-nested routes provide index/create/update/destroy. Current.account.canned_responses scopes lists, creation and update/destroy ID lookup. Permitted fields are short_code/content; create/update render the record, destroy sends empty OK. Model validates content/short_code/account presence and per-account short_code uniqueness.

Index renders a bare array. Search removes NUL, uses bound ILIKE substring conditions for short_code/content, and sanitize_sql_array for descending CASE ranking: shortcode prefix 1, shortcode substring 0.5, content substring 0.2. No explicit percent/underscore wildcard escaping is shown.

CannedResponse overrides extraction to response.data and marshalling to {data:rows}, adapting inherited payload defaults. Refetch commits extracted rows and returns the original response; cache hits marshal rows. Thus generic defaults do not establish a shape defect. Route-derived account selection drives URLs/cache_keys; dataManager changes when the route account changes. get(false) uses network; cache reads compare keys, refetch empty/invalid rows and fall back on initialization failure.

Request assertions cover unauthenticated access, array shape, search ranking, NUL removal and CRUD. Cache assertions cover account switching, cold/hit/changed-key paths, array parity and initialization fallback. Cache specs use subclass doubles; these are read assertions, not passing executions.

findings_or_risks: Independently checked cited immutable source before retaining worker findings. No runtime defect established.

Account-selection helper, cache revalidator and DataManager implementations are outside manifest; full authorization, invalidation/storage internals and in-flight account-switch behavior remain unverified.
